# Clearly

> Clearly is an iPhone co-parenting app for separated and divorced parents, built for high-conflict custody situations. Conversations happen in topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept. Before a post is shared, Clearly checks the tone and may suggest calmer wording; the writer chooses what to send, and every post stays on the record exactly as written. It also covers the custody schedule, expenses, and a shared parenting plan.

**Full-content version for AI systems:** https://getclearly.app/llms-full.txt — the substantive content of Clearly's key pages inlined in a single file.

Clearly is built for co-parents who find it hard to talk. Unlike apps that work as a shared inbox, Clearly organizes each conversation as a topic: a question answered with a one-tap Yes or No, an FYI acknowledged with OK, or a conversation that ends in a resolution both parents accept. Before you post, Clearly checks the tone and may suggest calmer wording. You choose what to send. Posts stay on the record as written: nothing is hidden and nothing is rewritten in transit. The AI is provided by Anthropic, photos are never sent to it, and Clearly never takes sides.

**Core positioning:** A co-parenting app built for high-conflict custody and hard conversations, designed to help co-parents reach resolution, not just keep a record.

**Platform:** iPhone only (no Android, iPad or web app).

**Pricing:** $24.99/month or $249/year (save $51). One family subscription covers both parents; the co-parent joins free with the invite code (they create their own account but don't pay). 14-day free trial (Apple introductory offer), starting when a parent subscribes. Free in-app demo, no account needed. Read-only without a subscription; records stay viewable and exportable. No free tier, per-parent pricing or lifetime plan.

**Maker:** Clearly LLC (independent company).

## What's in the app

- **Topics:** Questions get a one-tap Yes or No; FYIs are acknowledged with OK; conversations end in a resolution both parents accept, and "Not yet" keeps talking. Clearly titles topics and writes up what both parents agreed so both accept the same words. Topics and replies can't be edited or deleted once posted.
- **Tone check:** Before a post is shared, Clearly checks the tone and may suggest calmer wording. The writer chooses what to send; posts stay on the record exactly as written.
- **Where this stands:** For a quiet or circling topic, Clearly shows what's settled, what's still open, and a friendly next step. It suggests a fair middle ground only in a real disagreement.
- **Ask Clearly:** Answers questions about your record.
- **30-day closing rules:** A topic with no activity for 30 days closes and stays on the record. A resolution proposed but not accepted within 30 days closes as "not accepted"; it is never treated as agreed.
- **Schedule:** Custody calendar (2-2-3, 5-2-2-5, 3-4-4-3, week on/week off, every other weekend, or custom), holidays (alternating years, custom holidays), summer schedules, swap requests, and events. Add your schedule to Apple or Google Calendar with a private calendar link (one-way).
- **Expenses:** Log expenses with receipt photos, split them per the plan, see who owes what, tap Pay to open Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount filled in, then mark it paid.
- **Shared:** The parenting plan (custody schedule, holidays, summer, expense split), kids' details (including allergies and medications), and contacts.
- **Record and export:** Every topic and reply is time-stamped and kept as written. Export a PDF report (last 30 days, 90 days or all time) or all data as a spreadsheet (CSV).
- **Account deletion:** Settings → profile → Edit profile → Delete account.
- **AI and privacy:** AI is provided by Anthropic. Photos are never sent to the AI. Clearly never takes sides and never labels a parent.

## Who Clearly is for

- Parents navigating a high-conflict divorce or custody case.
- Parents who find it hard to talk with their co-parent without things escalating.
- Parents who want a calm, clear record of their co-parenting communication.
- Family-law attorneys, mediators, therapists, and parenting coordinators who want documented, low-conflict communication between clients.

## What makes Clearly different

- **Built to resolve, not just record.** Conversations are structured as topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept, with "Where this stands" to keep stalled topics moving.
- **A tone check, not a filter.** Clearly may suggest calmer wording before you post, but you choose what to send, and posts stay on the record exactly as written.
- **Built on established frameworks.** BIFF (Brief, Informative, Friendly, Firm) by Bill Eddy, nonviolent communication, parallel-parenting principles, and the Harvard Negotiation Project's "Getting to Yes" approach.
- **Designed by a parent who lived it.** Built by a parent who navigated their own divorce and found existing co-parenting apps inadequate for high-conflict situations.
- **A complete record.** The full record is time-stamped, kept as written, and exportable as a PDF.
